definitions.explanation: The respiratory organ in the chest. Used in both everyday and medical contexts.

examples.japanese: {肺|はい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}する→呼吸する：25333_kokyuusuru⟧。
{肺|はい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レントゲン→レントゲン：11219_rentogen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I had an X-ray of my lungs taken.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{肺|はい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}っている→弱る：02439_yowaru⟧。
examples.english: My lungs are weakened from years of smoking.

notes:
{肺|はい} is the organ responsible for breathing. Humans have two lungs (⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肺|はい}).

COMMON MEDICAL COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{肺炎|はいえん}→肺炎：08443_haien⟧: pneumonia
- {肺|はい}がん: lung cancer
- {肺活量|はいかつりょう}: lung capacity (vital capacity)
- {肺|はい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レントゲン→レントゲン：11219_rentogen⟧: lung X-ray
- {肺結核|はいけっかく}: pulmonary tuberculosis

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {肺|はい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧: to have weak lungs
- {肺|はい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまる: fluid in the lungs
- {肺|はい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{強|きた}える: to strengthen the lungs

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧: heart
- ⟦{気管|きかん}→気管：21172_kikan⟧: trachea, windpipe
- {気管支|きかんし}: bronchi
- ⟦{横隔膜|おうかくまく}→横隔膜：08101_oukakumaku⟧: diaphragm
